name: kept
title: Kept by the Generator Alone
html:
Kept by the Generator Alone

scm:pulls-get
watcher:watch
scm:merge
ci:build
hr:in-reply-to
ci:smoke-test
env:promote
scm:comment

Both scripts name the same relations, among them these. The promote's smoke, the one value the reasoner chose, is kept as an object, each count read from the smoke run, marked for review.

the promote, HAL-FORMS HAL-FORMS script, whole HAL Schema Forms script, whole
say: artie generate kept the HAL-FORMS walk as a script with no hand edits. Line them up with the HAL Schema Forms script: the same relations, in the same order. The one value the reasoner chose, the smoke counts on the promote, is kept as an object, each count read from the smoke run as the goal's words say, and marked for review. HAL-FORMS says only that the field is text; the goal's own words say what goes in it.

deck:fragment.name: hsf
deck:fragment.label: Kept from the HAL Schema Forms walk (release.heart.yaml)
deck:fragment.text:
steps:
  - act: scm:pulls-get
    fields:
      owner: ${owner}
      repo: ${repo}
      pull_number: ${pull}
    intent: Open pull request ${pull} of ${owner}/${repo}
    then:
      - keep-as: pr
  - enter: ${watcher}
    steps:
      - ask: watcher:watch
        fields:
          resource: ${pr.@self}
          offers: scm:merge
        reply: watch
  - once-answered:
      reply: watch
      steps:
        - enter: ${pr.@self}
          steps:
            - act: scm:merge
              fields:
                method: squash
              intent: merge it by squashing
              then:
                - check:
                    - field: state
                      is: closed
                    - field: merged
                      is: true
                    - field: mergeable_state
                      is: unknown
                - keep-as: merged
  - enter: ${jenkins}
    steps:
      - ask: ci:build
        fields:
          commit: ${merged.merge_commit_sha}
        reply: build
  - once-answered:
      reply: build
      steps:
        - follow: hr:in-reply-to
          intent: follow its in-reply-to link to the build
          then:
            - run-script: ci:smoke-test
              on-link: ci:deployment
              inputs:
                book: ${book}
                author: ${author}
                renewable: ${renewable}
                problem: ${problem}
                comment: ${comment}
              as: smoke
  - given:
      - at: smoke
        field: passed
        is: true
    then:
      - enter: ${dev}
        steps:
          - act: env:get-environment
            fields:
              id: ${environment}
            inferred: get environment ${environment}
            from-intent: open environment ${environment} and promote commit {merged.merge_commit_sha}, citing {smoke.passing} of {smoke.of} scenarios passed
            then:
              - act: env:promote
                fields:
                  commit: ${merged.merge_commit_sha}
                  smoke: # review: the reasoner chose it, asked "promote commit 30a0fa96e3eed2ae20b2b5fa7613a115d56312a3, citing 5 of 5 scenarios passed"
                    passed: ${smoke.passing}
                    of: ${smoke.of}
                intent: open environment ${environment} and promote commit {merged.merge_commit_sha}, citing {smoke.passing} of {smoke.of} scenarios passed
                then:
                  - check:
                      - field: commit
                        is: ${merged.merge_commit_sha}
    otherwise:
      - at: ${pr.@self}
        steps:
          - act: scm:comment
            fields:
              body: "Not promoted to Dev: smoke scenarios ${smoke.failed} failed."

deck:fragment.name: hf
deck:fragment.label: Kept from the HAL-FORMS walk (hal-forms/release.heart.yaml)
deck:fragment.text:
steps:
  - act: scm:pulls-get
    fields:
      owner: ${owner}
      repo: ${repo}
      pull_number: ${pull}
    intent: Open pull request ${pull} of ${owner}/${repo}
    then:
      - keep-as: pr
  - enter: ${watcher}
    steps:
      - ask: watcher:watch
        fields:
          resource: ${pr.@self}
          offers: scm:merge
        reply: watch
  - once-answered:
      reply: watch
      steps:
        - enter: ${pr.@self}
          steps:
            - act: scm:merge
              fields:
                method: squash
              intent: merge it by squashing
              then:
                - check:
                    - field: mergeable_state
                      is: unknown
                    - field: merged
                      is: true
                    - field: state
                      is: closed
                - keep-as: merged
  - enter: ${jenkins}
    steps:
      - ask: ci:build
        fields:
          commit: ${merged.merge_commit_sha}
        reply: build
  - once-answered:
      reply: build
      steps:
        - follow: hr:in-reply-to
          intent: follow its in-reply-to link to the build
          then:
            - run-script: ci:smoke-test
              on-link: ci:deployment
              inputs:
                book: ${book}
                author: ${author}
                renewable: ${renewable}
                problem: ${problem}
                comment: ${comment}
              as: smoke
  - given:
      - at: smoke
        field: passed
        is: true
    then:
      - enter: ${dev}
        steps:
          - act: env:get-environment
            fields:
              id: ${environment}
            inferred: open environment ${environment}
            from-intent: open environment ${environment} and promote commit {merged.merge_commit_sha}, citing {smoke.passing} of {smoke.of} scenarios passed
            then:
              - for-each: environment
                then:
                  - when-offered:
                      - act: env:promote
                        fields:
                          commit: ${merged.merge_commit_sha}
                          smoke: # review: the reasoner chose it, asked "promote commit 39590c7cd6242a278c59c230eb17f387161f38be, with the smoke field as an object: {"passed": 5, "of": 5} (5 of 5 scenarios passed)"
                            passed: ${smoke.passing}
                            of: ${smoke.of}
                        intent: open environment ${environment} and promote commit {merged.merge_commit_sha}, citing {smoke.passing} of {smoke.of} scenarios passed
                        then:
                          - check:
                              - field: commit
                                is: ${merged.merge_commit_sha}
                    intent: open environment ${environment} and promote commit {merged.merge_commit_sha}, citing {smoke.passing} of {smoke.of} scenarios passed
                    otherwise:
                      - note: none of these acts is offered here
    otherwise:
      - at: ${pr.@self}
        steps:
          - act: scm:comment
            fields:
              body: "Not promoted to Dev: smoke scenarios ${smoke.failed} failed."
